newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO TO ISSUE FIM 150 MLN FOUR-YEAR BOND.
newsitem.headline: ASKO TO ISSUE FIM 150 MLN FOUR-YEAR BOND.

text.p: Finnish furniture and plastic pipe maker Asko Oy said in a statement on Monday it will issue a 150 million markka four-year bond on November 18 to institutional investors.
"Asko Oy will issue ... a bond worth 150 million markka in maximum or higher, in case the issuer decides to raise the nominal value of the bond," Asko said.
The bond would finance future investments, Asko said but did not elaborate.
The bond will have a floating issue price and carry a 5.5 percent coupon, it said.
The subscription period will be November 18 to December 5, and the issue manager is state-owned Postipankki Oy, Asko said.
